claims.evidence: Photo 0 and Photo 2 show 'Canon' logo and 'EOS 5D' / 'MarkIII' lettering on the body.
No batteries are visible in any of the three photos; only the camera body is shown.
No charger is visible in any photo.
No trigger or hot shoe accessory is visible; hot shoe cover is in place in Photo 1.
Seller's description is cut off; no condition detail to compare against photos, which only show capped exterior views.

risks.risk: No lens included, only a body cap is shown
risks.proof: A photo showing a lens physically bundled with the body, or explicit confirmation none is included so pricing reflects body-only.

risks.risk: Camera functionality unknown (power on, autofocus, shutter operation)
risks.proof: A short video or photo of the camera powered on, showing the rear LCD active and a test shot or live view.
A photo of the shutter count from camera menu or a shutter-count app reading.
risks.if_unproven: Price as high shutter count (heavy use).

risks.risk: Rear LCD screen condition - appears off/blank in Photo 1
risks.proof: A photo or video with the screen powered on showing no dead pixels or cracks.
risks.if_unproven: Price as screen fault/non-working until shown otherwise.

risks.risk: Sensor and mirror condition unseen (lens mount capped)
risks.proof: A photo with the body cap removed showing the mirror box and sensor clean, no fungus or scratches.
risks.if_unproven: Price as sensor/mirror condition unknown, assume needs cleaning/service.

risks.risk: Claimed accessories (2 batteries, charger, Godox trigger) not shown in photos
risks.proof: A photo of all claimed accessories laid out together with the camera body.
risks.if_unproven: Price as body-only; accessories not counted until shown.

risks.risk: General cosmetic wear (scratches, dents) may be hidden by lighting/angle
risks.proof: Close-up photos of top plate, grip, and lens mount edges in even lighting.
risks.if_unproven: Price as moderate-to-heavy cosmetic wear until clearer photos are provided.

proof_requests: Photo of camera powered on with rear LCD screen active
Photo of shutter count from camera menu or an app
Photo with body cap removed showing mirror/sensor
Photo showing all claimed accessories (2 batteries, charger, Godox trigger) together with the body
Close-up photos of top, grip, and lens mount for cosmetic condition
Confirmation whether a lens is included or sold body-only
response.reason: The witness clearly identifies the item as a Canon EOS 5D Mark III body, so it can be priced at worst case (body-only, untested, unknown shutter count, no accessories confirmed) pending further proof.
